title: Ford Line Health Monitor
why: A Ford assembly plant depends on presses, welding robots and conveyors, and one unplanned breakdown can stop the whole line. This tool reads machine sensors, predicts which machine fails next and books the repair into planned downtime.
problem: Unexpected equipment failures are causing production downtime and increasing maintenance costs. Develop an AI system that analyzes machine sensor data, maintenance history and production schedules to identify failure patterns and recommend preventive maintenance actions.
data_note: 24 machines on one body-and-assembly line, 120 days of daily sensor readings and 3 years of failure history (sample data).

steps.detail: Vibration, temperature, motor current, work orders, schedule
Each sensor vs the machine's own healthy baseline (z-score)
Health index from combined z-scores, flag above 3
Trend of the health index to the failure level
Logistic model trained on past failure windows
Book each job into the last planned window before failure

questions: Which machine should we fix first?
What is causing most failures on this line?
Write a work order for the top-risk machine
How much money does this plan save?
author: K Mohan Kumar
